EnergyServicePointId.description: A unique identifier for an Energy service point, generated according to [CDR ID Permanence](#id-permanence) requirements.

reads.description: Array of meter reads sorted by NMI in ascending order followed by _readStartDate_ in descending order.

controlledLoad.description: Indicates whether the energy recorded by this register is created under a Controlled Load regime.

meterId.description: Meter id/serial number as it appears in customer's bill. ID permanence rules do not apply.

readEndDate.description: Date when the meter reads end in AEST. If absent then assumed to be equal to _readStartDate_. In this case the entry represents data for a single date specified by _readStartDate_.

readStartDate.description: Date when the meter reads start in AEST and assumed to start from 12:00am AEST.

readUType.description: Specify the type of the meter read data.

registerId.description: Register ID of the meter register where the meter reads are obtained.

registerSuffix.description: Register suffix of the meter register where the meter reads are obtained.

servicePointId.description: Unique identifier for the service point.

unitOfMeasure.description: Unit of measure of the meter reads. Refer to Appendix B of MDFF Specification NEM12 NEM13 v2.1 for a list of possible values.

quality.description: The quality of the read taken. If absent then assumed to be `ACTUAL`.

value.description: Meter read value. If positive then it means consumption, if negative it means export.

aggregateValue.description: The aggregate sum of the interval read values. If positive then it means net consumption, if negative it means net export.

intervalReads.description:
Array of Interval read values. If positive then it means consumption, if negative it means export. Required when _interval-reads_ query parameter equals `FULL` or `MIN_30`.
Each read value indicates the read for the interval specified by _readIntervalLength_ beginning at midnight of _readStartDate_ (for example 00:00 to 00:30 would be the first reading in a 30 minute Interval).

readIntervalLength.description: Read interval length in minutes. Required when _interval-reads_ query parameter equals `FULL` or `MIN_30`.

readQualities.description: Specifies quality of reads that are not `ACTUAL`. For read indices that are not specified, quality is assumed to be `ACTUAL`. If not present, all quality of all reads are assumed to be actual. Required when _interval-reads_ query parameter equals `FULL` or `MIN_30`.

endInterval.description: End interval for read quality flag.

quality.description: The quality of the read taken.

startInterval.description: Start interval for read quality flag. First read begins at `1`.

first.description: URI to the first page of this set. Mandatory if this response is not the first page.

last.description: URI to the last page of this set. Mandatory if this response is not the last page.

next.description: URI to the next page of this set. Mandatory if this response is not the last page.

prev.description: URI to the previous page of this set. Mandatory if this response is not the first page.

self.description: Fully qualified link that generated the current response document.

totalPages.description: The total number of pages in the full set. See [pagination](#pagination).

totalRecords.description: The total number of records in the full set. See [pagination](#pagination).
